checks.enforcement: Exact Factory Version and configuration digest are required by the routing pin and current verification join.
Readiness and pinning compare the exact immutable Factory configuration digest.
Factory readiness requires one current eligible canonical worker.
Remote admission compares exact profile ID and digest; qualification-only is rejected for production routing.
Worker repository access and routing evidence are exact repository-bound.
Unavailable catalog health excludes a tuple and cannot grant verification authority.
Missing values remain null/undefined and do not become successful or cost-complete evidence.
Factory, repository, profile, verifier, agent, and worker scopes are project checked.
Unknown/invalid frozen manifests and unsupported adapter versions fail admission.
